name: Xiaomi TV Stick 4K
summary: Xiaomi TV Stick 4K ships with telemetry, attribution and PatchWall rows. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Xiaomi TV Stick 4K ships with Xiaomi and Google telemetry and attribution, PatchWall content rows, promos and auto-installs. It also has preloaded apps that a stick does not need. Each app has its own switch in the app, so you decide which ones to turn off.

It is a streaming stick with no HDMI-in or tuner. The setup wizard does not claim Home here, so it can stay on and Wi-Fi does not need re-joining. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The stock Android TV home until a new one is chosen
notes: The Xiaomi update service is on the list. Re-enable it to check for firmware updates.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back on my Xiaomi TV Stick 4K?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap. TidyTV only switches apps off, so nothing is ever deleted.

faq.q: How do I check for firmware updates?
faq.a: Switch the Xiaomi update service back on in the app, check for updates, then switch it off again if you like.

faq.q: Does TidyTV delete anything on my Xiaomi TV Stick 4K?
faq.a: No. It turns apps off with Android's own setting, saves a backup first and checks each one. You can turn any app back on with its switch.
